sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup
sections.what: Imports the test tools and the phase, quantile, diversify functions and the candidate type.
sections.why: Gives the tests the functions they check.

sections.name: c
sections.title: Candidate builder
sections.what: Makes a made-up candidate with an id, match, season, phase, teams and leverage.
sections.why: Keeps the selection tests short and focused.
sections.watch_out: These candidates are invented and do not come from match data.

sections.name: golden-moment selection (moments)
sections.title: Selection rules
sections.what: Checks that balls left map to powerplay, middle and death phases. Checks the nearest-rank quantile. Checks that the highest leverage is picked first, with one moment per match and caps on season, phase and team. Checks that ties are broken by id and that moments sharing one answer are capped.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the bank varied and the choice repeatable.
sections.watch_out: The candidates are ranked by leverage before the caps apply, so a change to ranking order changes which moments survive.

summary: Checks the rules for choosing golden moments: phase by balls left, nearest-rank quantile, highest leverage first with caps, deterministic tie-breaks, and a cap on moments that share one answer.
purpose: Keeps the question selection fair and varied.
why: Likely reason: without caps, one match, season or team could dominate the question bank.
how: Builds synthetic candidates and runs the phase, quantile and diversify functions with various caps. Compares the outputs against the expected id lists.
inputs: Synthetic candidates created in the test.
risks: The order of the rules determines which moments are picked. Changing the order changes the results.
debug: Compare the expected id list with the actual list. Check the caps object used in the failing test.
